title: The Fourth Declension
subtitle: manus, manūs. The u-stems.
objectives: Decline fourth-declension nouns in all cases.
Recognize -ūs nominative singular as fourth-declension marker.

sections.heading: The fourth declension
sections.body:
Fourth-declension nouns end in -us (masc.) or -ū (neut.). Paradigm:

  Nom. manus, Gen. manūs, Dat. manuī, Acc. manum, Abl. manū
  Plural: manūs, manuum, manibus, manūs, manibus

Common nouns: manus (hand, f.), exercitus (army, m.), domus (house, f. irregular).
